must: Use Macintosh names only after behavior, lifecycle, caller, constant, string, table, signature, or ordering corroborates the x86 function.
Preserve Windows MSVC 4.00 ABI, layouts, physical TU boundaries, source-list order, and code generation.
Keep logical Macintosh class ownership separate from physical Windows TU ownership.
must_not: Transfer Macintosh ABI, object layout, vtable encoding, calling convention, or compiler behavior to Windows.
Split a mixed Windows TU or rename it after one dominant class without Windows compiler/link evidence.
Create wrappers, duplicate lifecycles, dead address-mapped methods, or speculative class storage.
